# hunch compile: examples

`compile` turns Agent Skills and `AGENTS.md` into review questions in `hunch.lock`. Here the shop's config selects its one skill and its root `AGENTS.md` (`skills: ["./.agents/skills/api-style"]`, `agentsMd: true`).

<!-- case: compile-dry -->
### What would be compiled?

```sh
npx -y --min-release-age=0 @kelbie/hunch compile --dry-run
```

Exit code **0**.

stdout:

```text
hunch: dry run, nothing compiled. 2 of 2 source(s) would be compiled.
  new        skill/api-style  .agents/skills/api-style/SKILL.md
  new        agents-md/root  AGENTS.md
```

<!-- /case -->

<!-- case: compile-noninteractive -->
### No terminal, no previous lock, no --with

An agent must say which compiler to use.

```sh
npx -y --min-release-age=0 @kelbie/hunch compile
```

Exit code **2**.

stderr:

```text
hunch: choose a compiler with --with claude, --with codex or --with gateway.
```

<!-- /case -->

<!-- case: compile-nothing -->
### Nothing to compile

```sh
npx -y --min-release-age=0 @kelbie/hunch compile --dry-run
```

Exit code **2**.

stderr:

```text
hunch: no skills, AGENTS.md or docs found to compile. Add an AGENTS.md, install a skill (`npx skills add <owner/repo>`), or list files under `docs` in the Hunch config; then run `npx @kelbie/hunch compile` again.
```

<!-- /case -->

<!-- case: compile-claude -->
### Compile with Claude Code

```sh
npx @kelbie/hunch compile --with claude --effort low
```

Not captured yet: this needs Claude Code installed and logged in. Run `bun scripts/skill-examples.ts --live` where that is available.
<!-- /case -->
